image_description: A market scene featuring a large pile of Dungeness crabs on crushed ice in the foreground. A person wearing a red jacket is visible on the left, holding up a handwritten sign. Another sign stands to the right. The background shows a busy market environment with other stalls and people.

The ice lacks distinct crystalline structure, appearing as a smeared, painterly texture rather than sharp, reflective ice chunks.
Several crabs in the middle of the pile appear to merge into one another without clear boundaries, suggesting a failure in object separation logic common in AI generation.
The hand holding the sign appears malformed and blends unnaturally with the red jacket sleeve, lacking clear finger definition.
